name: Blockyard Spigot
author: operator@blockyard.local
description: Reviewed Minecraft 1.21.1 installer. EULA acceptance is required separately. Loader variables are operator-managed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
rm -f .blockyard-install.json
curl --user-agent "Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)" --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --fail --location --retry 3 https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar -o BuildTools.jar
# Bound parent and child JVM heaps; Maven dependencies survive installation retries.
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=50.0"
export MAVEN_OPTS="-Xmx1024M -Dmaven.repo.local=/mnt/server/.build-cache/maven"
java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=25.0 -jar BuildTools.jar --rev "$DL_VERSION" --compile SPIGOT
mv "spigot-${DL_VERSION}.jar" server.jar
jar tf server.jar > /dev/null
# Build sources and caches are not part of the customer runtime.
rm -rf -- .build-cache BuildData Bukkit CraftBukkit Spigot work apache-maven-3.9.6 BuildTools.jar
printf '{"software":"SPIGOT","minecraft_version":"%s","loader_version":""}\n' "${DL_VERSION}" > .blockyard-install.json.tmp
mv .blockyard-install.json.tmp .blockyard-install.json

# First-install access defaults; preserve settings on reinstall.
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  printf 'online-mode=false\nwhite-list=false\n' > server.properties
fi
